justification: Standardises hardcoded SEPP Housing and land tax constants into DB tables with fallback. 5 modified files + 3 new files. Touches production query paths in granny_flat.py and conveyancing.py but with identical fallback behaviour — no change in output unless DB rows exist.

pre_impl.existing_data: housing_sepp_standards table (33 rows, used by 3 frontend TS routes). New: secondary_dwelling rows + tax_thresholds table.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If DB has no secondary_dwelling rows or tax_thresholds table doesn't exist, all code falls back to hardcoded values — identical to pre-PR behaviour.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Migration 045 inserts 2 new rows into existing table. Migration 046 creates new table + seeds 2 years. ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING for idempotency.

functions.name: fetch_sepp_housing_standards
functions.output: list[dict] with development_type, standard_type, numeric_value, unit, applicable_zones

functions.name: fetch_tax_thresholds
functions.output: Optional[dict] with tax_year, threshold_dollars, rate, base_amount_dollars, etc.
functions.if_none: conn=None → returns None. No row → returns None. DB error → returns None.

functions.name: _get_sepp_sd_standards
functions.input: conn (psycopg2 connection, optional — None triggers fallback)
functions.if_none: conn=None → returns fallback (450.0, 60.0). DB error → returns fallback.

functions.name: _load_regulatory_configs
functions.if_none: No DATABASE_URL → (None, None). DB error → (None, None).

functions.name: calc_feasibility
functions.input: controls, valuation, overlays + optional sepp_standards (dict), tax_config (dict)
functions.if_none: sepp_standards=None → uses fallback 450m². tax_config=None → uses fallback 2025 values.

values.guard_at: _get_sepp_sd_standards returns this on any failure path

values.if_missing: Falls back to hardcoded 450m² / R1-R4 zones — same as before this PR
Falls back to hardcoded 2025 thresholds — same as before this PR

values.nullable: no — column is NOT NULL in DB

queries.if_wrong: Wrong numeric_value would change lot size threshold — but values come from migration with exact legislative references

queries.purpose: Load SEPP housing standards filtered by dev_type and/or zone
queries.if_zero: Returns empty list — caller uses fallback
queries.if_wrong: Zone filter uses ANY(applicable_zones) array containment — correct for array column

queries.purpose: Load tax thresholds for a given year/jurisdiction
queries.where_clause: WHERE jurisdiction = %s AND tax_type = %s AND tax_year = %s
queries.if_wrong: UNIQUE constraint on (jurisdiction, tax_type, tax_year) prevents duplicates

break_it.scenario: Migration 046 not run — tax_thresholds table doesn't exist
break_it.what_happens: fetch_tax_thresholds catches exception, returns None. calc_feasibility uses _LT_FALLBACK. User sees identical output to pre-PR.
break_it.how: Every DB-sourced path has try/except returning fallback values
break_it.repro: Run app without running migration 046, generate conveyancing report

break_it.scenario: Someone inserts wrong numeric_value (e.g. 4500 instead of 450) into housing_sepp_standards
break_it.what_happens: Granny flat threshold would be 4500m² — almost no lots would qualify. Reports would show incorrect 'lot too small' warnings.
break_it.how: No DB-level CHECK constraint on numeric_value range. Mitigated by: values come from migration with legislative source_clause references, and existing frontend routes already use this table.
break_it.repro: UPDATE housing_sepp_standards SET numeric_value = 4500 WHERE standard_type = 'min_lot_size' AND development_type = 'secondary_dwelling'

break_it.what_happens: _load_regulatory_configs returns (None, None). calc_feasibility uses all fallback values. Output identical to pre-PR.
break_it.how: services/conveyancing.py:_load_regulatory_configs checks db_url first, returns (None, None) immediately
break_it.repro: Unset DATABASE_URL env var, hit /api/conveyancing endpoint

post_merge.db_reset: No — but migration 045 + 046 should be run to activate DB-sourced values
post_merge.manual_verify: Run migrations 045 + 046 on Supabase, then verify granny flat detect and conveyancing report use DB values
